evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU shall initiate a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number if position or other data in a PPLI meet decorrelation criteria.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is not found, the C2 JU shall integrate the received J2 PPLI report into its surveillance database. If subsequent J2 messages are not received and no local data exists, the C2 JU assumes no responsibility for reporting on the Surveillance Network PG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the sequence of actions for handling uncorrelated data and the conditions for assuming responsibility for reporting.

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU shall assume R2 (Responsibility for Reporting) of an IU in accordance with real-time track reporting rules if it has correlated local sensor data and: (a) no J2 PPLI message is received for 40 to 60 seconds, (b) a J2 PPLI message other than J2.0 is received with NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence, (c) a J7.0 Drop Track message is received, or (d) the Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific conditions under which the C2 JU transitions into a state where it assumes responsibility for reporting, triggering the subsequent reporting steps.

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU assuming R2 of an IU reports it as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG. The Identity shall be reported as Friend. Track Number, Platform, and Platform Activity values from previous PPLI messages shall be reported. PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator shall be reported as value 1 and maintained if another C2 JU assumes R2.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exact reporting actions and field values the C2 JU must use once it has assumed R2 of an IU.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JU shall provide the optimum exchange of surveillance information on the network by correlating and correlating (dual designating) all remote data with local tracks (or vice versa) and minimizing dual designations.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary operational action the C2 JU performs to achieve the use case goal.

evidence_cards.content: Track reporting requires a set of rules which are general in nature and which may be adapted to a specific interface configuration to provide an optimum exchange of data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the requirement to follow reporting rules to enable the track exchange.

evidence_cards.content: Each Air and Surface Track Dual Designation, a track for which positional data has been locally derived and is not currently being reported by another C2 JU, shall report the position of the track extrapolated to the time of the report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the specific action the C2 JU must take regarding position reporting (extrapolation) and handling of dual designations (reporting).

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not automatically correlate two tracks if the remote report being tested is a J2.0 Indirect PPLI message with the Originator E/C field set to value 0 (Surface) or 3 (Air), unless processed for correlation like a J3.2 air or J3.3 surface (maritime) track with TQ = 7.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a restriction on the normal processing flow for automatic correlation of J2.0 Indirect PPLI messages, which is part of the main interaction sequence for the C2 JU.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not automatically correlate two tracks if the two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a specific condition that restricts automatic correlation during the main flow of track management.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not automatically correlate two tracks if they have different Mode II codes and the local Mode II code is current.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a specific condition that restricts automatic correlation during the main flow of track management.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not automatically correlate two tracks if both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks being updated with local positional data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a specific condition that restricts automatic correlation during the main flow of track management.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not inhibit correlation if either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1 or set to No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the conditions under which the correlation restriction related to track strength is waived in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of a J2 or J3 message on the track, the C2 JU shall automatically test for correlation against remote tracks (not common local tracks) in accordance with paragraphs 4.4.4.3.1f and g.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the initial step in the main flow for executing decorrelation upon receiving surveillance track data.

evidence_cards.content: If the automatic correlation test fails, the C2 JU shall assign a new TN (TN B) to the local track and report TN B in a J3.2 or J3.3 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system's action when the track identity is confirmed as distinct from remote tracks.

evidence_cards.content: For each of the Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields implemented by a C² JU, the JU shall accept all defined field values for retransmission and operator appreciation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the behavior of the C2 JU when receiving track data, which is part of the interaction flow.

evidence_cards.content: Values accepted for retransmission shall be retransmitted if the JU assumes R² (Track Assumption), unless the JU holds locally derived data other than No Statement (non-NS) for the field which differs from the value accepted for retransmission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the condition under which the C2 JU must retransmit track data, a key step in the publishing flow.

evidence_cards.content: In the case where the JU holds locally derived non-NS data that differs from the accepted value, the JU shall report the locally derived data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the alternative action in the retransmission flow when local data takes precedence.

evidence_cards.content: As an exception, non-NS data for the Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type fields received from the controlling unit for the track shall be retransmitted regardless of locally derived data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific exception to the retransmission logic that the C2 JU must follow.

evidence_cards.content: If the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1, it shall be retransmitted as value 1 by any JU assuming R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a mandatory retransmission requirement for a specific field value.

evidence_cards.content: The JU with R2 shall report all IFF/SIF valid data locally held for the track in the J3 messages according to specific validity criteria: 'No Data' (zeroes in Mode Code field if no valid code is held) or 'Valid Data' (entered as the nonzero code in the Mode Code field).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary action (reporting data) for the main flow of surveillance reporting.

evidence_cards.content: Valid data is determined by receiving valid code responses from own sensors on two or more successive interrogations for Modes I, II, and III with the same value; or one interrogation for Mode IV, manually entered codes, or codes accepted according to the IFF/SIF Difference Resolution Matrix.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the data validation logic and timing thresholds required for the main flow action.

evidence_cards.content: Any change in IFF/SIF code values from No Data to Valid Data or from Valid Data to other Valid Data shall be reported as occurring.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the sequence of reporting events (transitions) within the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: Tracks with Valid Data which subsequently fail to respond to interrogations shall not be changed to the No Data status unless a Clear action is taken.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific condition for the main flow where the state does not change (maintaining Valid Data status) despite lack of sensor response, requiring an explicit Clear action.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU has not received a remote report on a locally held Air or Surface track for approximately 40 seconds, it assumes R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific time threshold condition that triggers a change in track ownership (R²), which is a key part of the exchange protocol.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU has not received a remote report on a locally held Land track for approximately 120 seconds, it assumes R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific time threshold condition that triggers a change in track ownership (R²) for land tracks.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a locally held track and reporting eligibility remains, it assumes R² at the next opportunity to transmit.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific message trigger (J7.0 with ACT=0) that causes a JU to assume track ownership (R²).

evidence_cards.content: Upon receiving a J2 PPLI message with NPS Indicator set to Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure from a JU that has R², the receiving JU may assume R² at the next opportunity.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies specific status conditions within the PPLI message that trigger a JU to assume track ownership (R²).

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report where the remote TQ is greater than the local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the primary mechanism for transferring track ownership (relinquishing R²) based on the Time Quality (TQ) field in the track report.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report where the TQ is equal to the local TQ, but only if the remote JU's STN is greater than the local STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the tie-breaking mechanism for transferring track ownership when TQ values are equal.

evidence_cards.content: After initially achieving Active status, or after returning to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure, the C2 JU must wait a minimum of 12 seconds (for air and surface tracks) and 48 seconds (for land tracks) before transmitting surveillance tracks.

evidence_cards.content: The minimum wait period required before reporting is a result of performing sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the processing steps (responsibility checks, correlation, data registration) that occur during the wait phase of the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: The system design shall allow for longer wait times or an override where operational necessity requires a shorter wait time or none at all.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, on a locally held track shall assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific condition under which a JU assumes R² (Responsibility for reporting), a key part of the interaction flow.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track (TQ field set to 0) shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the procedure for assuming R² for nonreal-time tracks.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a primary condition for relinquishing R² (Responsibility) in real-time tracks.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² on a track retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the above rules or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the duration and scope of R² responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: After applying all the above rules, a JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a tie-breaking scenario for relinquishing R² in real-time tracks.

evidence_cards.content: A unit assuming R² for a ballistic missile track need not assume R² for the associated launch point. The unit no longer holding R² on the ballistic missile track may continue to report the launch point in accordance with the transmit/receive rules.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies special handling for ballistic missile tracks and their associated launch points regarding R².

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R² and the TNs are different, the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message shall be transmitted with the Source TN as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the alternative processing path when receiving a correlation from a remote JU (non-owning JU), diverging from the flow where the C2 JU holds reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R² and the TNs are the same, the C2 JU accepts the PPLI information into its surveillance database and disregards the J31 surveillance data on that specific track, except when Geodetic Position values in the PPLI message are below 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the alternative path for correlation acceptance when Track Numbers match, requiring data acceptance while suppressing the specific local surveillance transmission.

evidence_cards.content: If the position or other data in a PPLI meet a system's PPLI data availability rules, the C2 JU shall correlate a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number. The PPLI Track Number and Identity shall be accepted into the surveillance database, and the C2 JU shall perform the applicable correlation and conflict processing necessary to ensure that duplicative information is not being transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the alternative flow for handling PPLI reports that do not match an existing local track, requiring the creation of a new local track and subsequent correlation checks.

evidence_cards.content: Subsurface tracks shall not be correlated with IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exclusionary rule (exception) for the correlation process.

evidence_cards.content: If correlation fails to properly correlate track data with remote data, a dual designation may occur, which requires specific protocols to minimize its duration and occurrence.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative scenario to successful correlation where the system must handle the failure state (dual designation) instead of merging tracks, diverging from the normal correlation steps.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data indicates that the two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict (see paragraph 4.4.4.3.1i), although this automatic restriction can be inhibited by an initialization parameter and operator selectable capability.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific alternative flow (branch) from the main correlation logic where automatic correlation is inhibited if the Strength field exceeds 1.

evidence_cards.content: When the remote report being tested for correlation is a J2.0 Indirect PPLI message with the Originator E/C field set to value 0 (Surface) or 3 (Air), it shall be processed for correlation like a J3.2 air or J3.3 surface (maritime) track with TQ = 7.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative processing path for specific remote reports (J2.0 Indirect PPLI) during correlation testing.

evidence_cards.content: If two tracks have different Mode II codes and the local code is current (Mode 4/13/Code), the system shall have an initialization parameter and operator selectable capability to inhibit automatic correlation restriction, allowing for manual correlation via voice or other media.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is not received for the dropped TN within 60 seconds of the correlation request, the correlation is deemed failed and processing is cancelled.

evidence_cards.content: If correlation fails (no J7.0 message received within 60 seconds), the C2 JU shall retain the Dropped TN as a remote track and shall not reattempt correlation for 60 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the specific recovery path and exclusion period when the correlation process fails to complete.

evidence_cards.content: If automatic correlation test fails during the execution of the Decorrelation process (diverging from the main flow of maintaining a common local track), assign a new TN (TN B) to the local track and report TN B in a J3.2 or J3.3 message.

evidence_cards.content: When reported on the Surveillance NPG by a C² JU, a TQ value as specified in Table 4.4-7 shall be initially assigned to a track not locally acquired but obtained via a J12.6 Target Sorting message from a nonC² JU. evidence_cards.content: For Subsurface tracks, the first JU to report a contact assumes reporting responsibility (R²) for that Track Number, and no other JU shall report the contact using that same track number, unless specific conditions are met (a J7.0 Drop Track message is received containing the TN, or a J3.4 message containing the TN is not received for two consecutive periodic updates).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative reporting path (sharing or re-reporting a track) for Subsurface contacts that diverges from standard single-reporter expectations, fulfilling the alternative flow slot requirements for Subsurface Surveillance.

evidence_cards.content: Any other JU may report what it believes to be the same Subsurface contact using a different TN. evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative flow where multiple JUs report the same contact using distinct Track Numbers, with constraints on data content, which is a specific divergence from standard reporting protocols.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU determines a Subsurface IU is no longer active on the interface and holds local data, it shall assume R² by reporting a J3.4 Subsurface Track message using the inactive IU address as the reference TN. evidence_cards.content: If a C2 JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message from a Friend JU (FJU) for a track where it has Reporting Responsibility (R²), and the Track Number (TN) is the same as the retained TN, it shall cease reporting the track.

evidence_cards.content: If a C2 JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message from a FJU for a track where another C2 JU has R² and the TNs are different, the C2 JU shall transmit a J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message with the FJU's TN as the Retained TN and its own surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.

evidence_cards.content: (b) If the received Strength field (J2.2 or J2.3) is set to 0, the PPLI shall not be correlated automatically. However, if a J2.2 or J2.3 with Qpg = 0 is set to No Statement, automatic correlation shall not be inhibited.

evidence_cards.content: If local or remote data indicates that TN A is the Target TN of a J10.2 Engagement Status message for a current engagement reported and conducted by own unit, or is the Reference TN or Target TN of a J10.2 message for a current engagement reported by own unit and conducted by another unit, the C2 JU decorrelates and alerts an operator as a cue to transmit the J10.2 message with the Weapon Engagement Status field set to value 8 (Engagement Broken) if appropriate. Another J10.2 message with the new TN shall be transmitted only if initiated by operator action, by a WILCO response to a J12.0 Mission Assignment against TN B, or by receipt of a J12.6 Target Sorting message reporting an engagement against TN B.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies an alternative decorrelation path based on engagement status conflicts, diverging from standard correlation procedures.

evidence_cards.content: If local or remote data indicates that TN A is the subject of a pending J9.0 Command message which own unit originated or to which own unit is preparing a reply, the C2 JU executes the decorrelation and provides operator display of new track status on TNs A and B before release of the J9.0 reply. The reply shall be relative to TN A only.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies an alternative decorrelation path required to resolve pending command messages.

evidence_cards.content: If local or remote data indicates that TN A is controlled by own unit (is the subject of own unit reported J10.5 Controlling Unit Report message), the C2 JU shall not automatically decorrelate. If manually decorrelated, the operator must be alerted as a cue to report termination of control of TN A if appropriate. Report of commencement of control of TN B using the J10.5 message is permitted only if initiated by operator action. If the controlled track is a nonC2 JU, the C2 JU decorrelates and continues reporting control of TN A.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a restrictive alternative path for controlled tracks, preventing automatic decorrelation.

evidence_cards.content: If local or remote data indicates that TN A has been paired by own unit (is the subject of own unit originated J10.6 message), the C2 JU decorrelates and alerts an operator as a cue to terminate the pairing on TN A and initiate the pairing on TN B if appropriate.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies an alternative decorrelation path to resolve track pairing conflicts.

evidence_cards.content: When a C2 JU receives a J12.6 Target Sorting message from a nonC2 JU for a track not locally acquired, it is required to initially assign a Target Quality (TQ) value based on the Target Position Quality (TPQ) in Table 4.4-7. evidence_cards.content: If a JU has not received a remote report on a locally held Air or Surface track for approximately 40 seconds, or on a locally held Land track for approximately 120 seconds, the JU assumes R² for that track.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a locally held track, the JU assumes R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time Air, Surface, or Land track upon reception of a remote track report in which remote TQ is greater than the local TQ, or upon reception of a remote report for a track with TQ equal to local TQ from a JU whose STN is greater than the local STN.

evidence_cards.content: If local/remote data indicates any of the following conditions, correlation restrictions apply: (1) No applicable Initial Correlation Status in the merge orientation reference file; (2) The TN is the subject of a pending J9.0 Command message originated by the C2 JU; (3) The two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which cannot be reconciled by an initialization parameter and operator selectable capability; (4) The track has been promulgated as a C2 track; (5) Both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks; or (6) Either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1. evidence_cards.content: If correlation fails due to the local track being the subject of a handover (J10.3) in progress, the C2 JU shall delay decorrelation until the handover is completed or terminated, then execute the decorrelation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a conditional alternative path for decorrelation when a handover process is active.

evidence_cards.content: Values accepted for retransmission shall be retransmitted if the JU assumes R², unless the JU holds locally derived data other than No Statement (non-NS) for the field which differs from the value accepted for retransmission; in that case, the JU shall report the locally derived data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a conditional branching scenario (divergence) where the JU may report locally derived data instead of retransmitted data for fields like Platform and Platform Activity.

evidence_cards.content: As an exception, non-NS data for the Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type fields received from the controlling unit for the track shall be retransmitted regardless of locally derived data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies an override condition where locally derived data is ignored in favor of controlling unit data for specific identity fields.

evidence_cards.content: If the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1, it shall be retransmitted as value 1 by any JU assuming R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a strict retransmission requirement for a specific field value, diverging from the general rule of reporting locally derived data.

evidence_cards.content: After initially achieving Active status, or after returning to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure, the C2 JU waits a minimum of 12 seconds (for air/surface) or 48 seconds (for land) before beginning transmission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the mandatory delay period after activation, diverging from the main flow by establishing specific wait times for air and surface tracks.

evidence_cards.content: When different TNs are used to report the same track, the C2 JU shall not generate a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message immediately; instead, it waits for a specified time period. The wait time is 30 seconds for air and surface, and 45 seconds for land.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative handling procedure for track identity discrepancies (TN conflicts) rather than immediate dropping, specifying the wait times to avoid premature termination.

evidence_cards.content: The specific message used to report Subsurface surveillance tracks is the J3.4 Track (Air, Mar, 01) message, transmitted when a JU ceases reporting and relinquishes R², except in cases 4.8.4 and 4.8.4.2.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Provides specific alternative message types and conditions for Subsurface tracks, diverging from standard Air/Surface reporting messages.

evidence_cards.content: When that track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN, track reporting criteria are based on the requirements for the exchange of Subsurface surveillance information and data useable in providing threat warning information for Subsurface surveillance tracks in joint operations.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Outlines an alternative reporting behavior when a track becomes an Active IU with a matching TN, referencing specific Subsurface surveillance exchange requirements.

evidence_cards.content: If contact is lost, the C² JU may report the track as a DATUM. The decision to do so is an operator function. If reported, the DATUM is sent in a J3.4 message using the same Reference TN as the lost track, with the Data Report Type (DRT) set to 4 (DATUM), ASW Time Function set to 3 (Time Contact Lost) or 1 (Time Datum Established), Hour/Minute set to the time contact was lost, and Latitude/Longitude/Depth set to the last known position.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a specific alternative path for handling a lost contact that diverges from the main flow of continuous surveillance reporting.

evidence_cards.content: When a track becomes an active IU on the network with the same address as a previously reported track but a different TN, and when the JU is Active, only locally derived data shall be reported in the J3.4 message; the J3.4 messages shall not contain data derived only by the reception of remote data from other IU(s) reporting the same contact.

source_locations.location: Middle section under header '4.4.5.13 TERMINATION OF SUBSURFACE TRACK DATA', paragraph (2)
Middle section under header '4.4.5.13 TERMINATION OF SUBSURFACE TRACK DATA', paragraph (2)

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific exception path for data reporting (subsurface tracks) where remote data reception is excluded when transitioning from inactive to active status.

evidence_cards.content: When a C2 JU determines that the Subsurface IU is no longer active on the network and the JU has local data on the IU, the JU shall assume R² by reporting a J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message using the inactive IU Address (DRT = 4) as the reference TN. No other JU shall report the inactive IU using other than the inactive IU address as the reference TN.

source_locations.location: Section '4.4.5.11 REPORTING INACTIVE INTERFACE UNITS AS SUBSURFACE SURVEILLANCE TRACKS', second paragraph
Section '4.4.5.11 REPORTING INACTIVE INTERFACE UNITS AS SUBSURFACE SURVEILLANCE TRACKS', second paragraph

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative flow for handling the loss of a remote track's active status, requiring the C2 JU to assume reporting responsibility and use the inactive IU address as the reference TN.

evidence_cards.content: Should the inactive IU return to Active status and the C2 JU is holding R², the JU shall cease reporting the IU, but a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.

source_locations.location: Section '4.4.5.11 REPORTING INACTIVE INTERFACE UNITS AS SUBSURFACE SURVEILLANCE TRACKS', third paragraph

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a termination condition for the inactive reporting flow where the track returns to active status, specifying that reporting ceases but a specific termination message (J7.0) is suppressed.

evidence_cards.content: If a track report with a different Track Number (TN) is received for a track where the C2 JU has Reporting Responsibility (R2) but a correlation is not found, the C2 JU shall not attempt correlation again for a period of 60 seconds.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a specific exception handling path for correlation failures regarding R2 tracks, specifying the action (do not reattempt) and the duration constraint (60 seconds).

evidence_cards.content: If the position or other data in a PPLI meet a system's data validation criteria and are deemed unacceptable, the Surveillance JU shall not correlate the PPLI information with its locally held data. Instead, it shall create a new surveillance track report with a new Track Number and Identity.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the exception path when incoming PPLI data fails validation, requiring the creation of a new track rather than correlating.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or IU, and a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R², the C2 JU transmits a J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message (Source TN as Retained TN, surveillance TN as Dropped TN) and ceases reporting the track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the exception handling for receiving a Drop Track message during a conflict resolution scenario.

evidence_cards.content: When a J12.6 message is received on the Surveillance Network PG and the Track Quality values indicate the track has been lost, the C2 JU shall discard the message unless the track number and identity are maintained if another C2 JU assumes R² of the IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the exception behavior for J12.6 messages indicating track loss, specifically the discard protocol.

evidence_cards.content: Failure to properly correlate data received from a remote source (e.g., lack of correlation within 60 seconds for correlation requests) results in the C2 JU retaining the Dropped Track Number (TN) as a remote track and refraining from reattempting correlation for 60 seconds.

source_locations.location: Page 24, paragraph 4.4.1 (b) and 4.4.2, and Page 25, paragraph (c)
Page 24, paragraph 4.4.1 (b) and 4.4.2, and Page 25, paragraph (c)

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the exception handling behavior when a standard correlation process fails or times out, defining the system's state and subsequent actions.

evidence_cards.content: In response to a correlation request from another unit, if the correlation test is not completed within 6 seconds after the extrapolation time, the C2 JU does not correlate. Instead, it considers the local track to correlate to the closest remote track or IU that meets all correlation tests and restrictions.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific error handling path (exception) for a correlation timeout condition.

evidence_cards.content: Manual correlation is prevented (exception) if the tracks are of different E/C, if one track is simulated and the other is live, or if both tracks are remote.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the error conditions under which the manual correlation capability must be inhibited.

evidence_cards.content: Exception Condition 1: If local/remote data indicates an Identity (ID) conflict, automatic correlation is inhibited; the system uses an initialization parameter and operator selectable capability to inhibit this restriction if required, with interface coordination and promulgation to all participating C2 IUs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an automatic inhibition (exception handling) for track correlation due to Identity conflicts and the specific override procedure.

evidence_cards.content: Exception Condition 2: If the two tracks have different Mode II codes and the local Mode II code is current, automatic correlation is inhibited; systems must have an initialization parameter and operator selectable capability to inhibit this restriction under the same coordination rules as the ID conflict.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an automatic inhibition (exception handling) for track correlation due to Mode II code conflicts.

evidence_cards.content: Exception Condition 3: If both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks (being updated with local positional data), automatic correlation is inhibited.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an automatic inhibition (exception handling) to prevent correlating two local real-time tracks.

evidence_cards.content: Exception Condition 4: If either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1, automatic correlation is inhibited. However, if the Strength is set to 'No Statement', correlation shall not be inhibited.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an automatic inhibition (exception handling) based on track strength parameters and specifies the exception for 'No Statement'.

evidence_cards.content: The correlation shall be deemed to have failed if no J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received for the dropped Track Number (TN) after a period of 60 seconds from the transmission of the correlation request, and all associated processing for the correlation shall be cancelled.

source_locations.location: Section k, 'Execution of the Correlation' (paragraph 2 of section k)

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific failure condition and exit path for a correlation attempt.

evidence_cards.content: If the own unit has R² for the Dropped TN, it transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message. If the Dropped TN is subsequently reported by another IU after transmission, the own unit retains it as a remote track and shall not reattempt to correlate the Retained TN and Dropped TN for a period of 60 seconds after transmission of the J7.0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific exception handling path and cooldown period when a conflicting track report is received after a drop message is sent.

evidence_cards.content: Under conditions of irregular reporting of nonreal-time tracks, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted to purge the track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies an exception or constraint on the 'purge' action (deactivation) when tracks are nonreal-time, which is a specific error or unexpected condition handling path.

evidence_cards.content: In the event of conflict between locally derived information and information reported on the interface, the C² JU shall resolve the difference by transmitting the appropriate J7 message, by operator procedure, or by voice coordination.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific exception handling procedure (conflict resolution) for data discrepancies.

evidence_cards.content: A J3.7I word shall be transmitted with FIX BRG field set to value 1, and a J3.7C2 word is included to define the AOP (Area of Probability) when reporting an AOP based on a single EW fix.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the exception handling flow for reporting an Area of Probability (AOP) derived from EW data, specifying the exact message fields required (J3.7I, J3.7C2) to handle this specific surveillance scenario.

evidence_cards.content: An AOP resulting from two or more previously reported fixes of differing Track Numbers (TNs) shall be assigned a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the fixes; this new TN is used for subsequent updates of the AOP.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exception rule for handling conflicting Track Numbers when generating an AOP, dictating the creation of a new unique identifier to resolve the data inconsistency.

evidence_cards.content: When an EW fix is changed by the AOP, the TN of the previously reported fix shall be used for the new AOP, diverging from the general rule of assigning a new TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific exception condition where a previously reported fix dictates the Track Number for a new AOP, providing a recovery path for changing EW data.

evidence_cards.content: The unit originating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report always retains reporting responsibility; it is illegal to assume reporting responsibility for another unit's AOP.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a mandatory constraint and error prevention path for Electronic Warfare (EW) data, prohibiting unauthorized assumption of reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: Initiating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report requires the unit to assign a Track Number (TN) not known to be in use on the network to avoid duplicates, except when the unit is tracking a target reported by another JU with the same TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the exception logic for Track Number assignment in EW scenarios, mandating unique TNs and defining the specific condition (same TN) where this is permitted.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from a FJU for a track where the C2 JU has R² and the Track Numbers (TNs) are different, the C2 JU transmits a J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message with the Source TN in the Header word as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the exception handling path triggered by a Drop Track message, specifying the required response to resolve the conflict.

evidence_cards.content: When the C2 JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message for a track for which it has R², it shall cease reporting the track and transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message to the Surveillance Network PG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the specific exit path (cease reporting and drop) upon successful receipt of a Drop Track message for a track under C2 JU responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: If a J12.6 Target Sorting message is received for a track where the C2 JU has R², the C2 JU shall accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and disregard the J31 surveillance data on that specific track, except when Geodetic Position values in the PPLI message are set to value 0, in which case the track number and identity shall be maintained if another C2 JU assumes R² of the IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This exception handles the conflict between existing surveillance data and new PPLI data from a sorting message, defining when the existing track is replaced versus maintained.

evidence_cards.content: If a local track fails a correlation test against a remote track or IU (and no other correlation is found), it is considered uncorrelated and treated as a new local track, triggering a new reporting cycle with a new Track Number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific exception handling path for correlation failure, where the system defaults to a 'new track' state instead of merging data.

evidence_cards.content: If a local track tentatively correlates but subsequently fails the correlation test, or if a second correlation attempt with the same remote track fails, the local track is treated as a new local track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific exception path where a tentative success turns into a failure, forcing the system to re-evaluate the track as new.

evidence_cards.content: If an operator action is taken to deliberately re-test a newly localized track for correlation, the test shall be performed regardless of the result of the automatic correlation test.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception override condition where manual operator intervention bypasses the standard correlation logic.

evidence_cards.content: For air tracks, if the local track Altitude Source is 1 or 3 but the remote track is an IU reported in a PPLI message (i.e., altitude source is 2), the altitude test is not used in the correlation test.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a boundary condition where standard correlation parameters (altitude) are excluded due to data quality/source discrepancies.

evidence_cards.content: If a common local track satisfies criteria for decorrelation (e.g., when correlation is inhibited by Identity conflict, different Mode II codes, both tracks being locally derived real-time, or Strength field > 1), the C2 JU shall not automatically correlate the tracks and shall report the track using the rules for dual designations to minimize the duration and occurrence of the dual designation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This detail defines the specific exception flow for handling data conflicts where automatic correlation is blocked, specifying the subsequent reporting behavior (dual designation rules) required to manage the error condition.

evidence_cards.content: If the use of capability to inhibit automatic restrictions (due to ID conflicts or Mode II differences) changes, the C2 JU must inform all participating IUs through voice communication or other communications media.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This detail defines the communication exception path that must be followed when a system operator overrides the automatic correlation restriction.

evidence_cards.content: Upon execution of correlation, if no J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received for the dropped Track Number (TN) within a period of 60 seconds from the transmission of the correlation request, the correlation is deemed to have failed and all associated processing shall be cancelled.

source_locations.location: Section k. Execution of the Correlation

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception condition where correlation fails due to lack of response (no J7.0), resulting in cancellation of processing.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU holds Reporting Responsibility (R²) for the Dropped TN, it transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message. If the Dropped TN is subsequently reported by another IU after the Drop Track message is sent, the C2 JU retains the Dropped TN as a remote track and shall not reattempt to correlate the Retained TN and the Dropped TN for a period of 60 seconds after transmission of the J7.0.

source_locations.location: Section k. Execution of the Correlation, subsection (b)

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception handling path for R² tracks where the correlation result is contradicted by a subsequent report, triggering a temporary hold on re-correlation (60 seconds) and treating the track as remote.

evidence_cards.content: If a C2 JU receives a track on the Surveillance NPG from a J12.6 Target Sorting message from a non-C2 JU (a track not locally acquired) and the C2 JU has NOT correlated local sensor data for that track, an exception condition exists where the C2 JU must initially assign a TQ value per Table 4.4-7 and extrapolate the received target's position to the time of transmission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific exception flow in data handling (correlated vs non-correlated local sensor data) where the standard processing is modified to enforce specific TQ assignment rules.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message (Drop Track) for a locally held track, it must assume R² and immediately test the track for correlation according to specific paragraph rules, but limit the test to a single occurrence.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception handling procedure for receiving a Drop Track message, mandating immediate correlation testing.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU receives a J2 PPLI message indicating NPS Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure from another JU, the receiving JU may assume R² and report the track if local reporting eligibility remains.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception handling path triggered by specific status indicators (NPS/RS/TDS Failure) in received PPLI messages.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU has R² but receives a remote track report with a TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU with a higher STN, the JU must relinquish R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception condition where Reporting Responsibility must be relinquished due to specific criteria in a remote track report (equal TQ, higher STN).

evidence_cards.content: A JU must assume R² for a locally held nonreal-time track with TQ = 0 if no remote report is received after the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception handling procedure for nonreal-time tracks where reporting responsibility is assigned due to local updates.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation of a common local track to another remote track or IU is found, the C2 JU transmits a Correlation message (J7.2, RV = 1). The C2 JU reports the common local track using the common local Track Number (TN), transmits a J7.0 message for the Dropped TN, and ceases reporting on the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is an exception handling path for the correlation process when a common track is re-correlated; it defines the specific messages (J7.2, J7.0) and state changes (ceasing report) required.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data indicates any of the following conditions exist: (1) The two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict; (2) The two tracks have different Mode II codes and the local Mode II code is current; (3) Both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks, i.e., being updated with local positional data; (4) Either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1. However, the system shall not inhibit correlation if either track has Strength set to No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This section explicitly lists the 'Correlation Restrictions' (exceptions) that prevent automatic correlation of tracks, directly satisfying the requirement for exception handling paths in the exception_flow slot.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU has R² for a Dropped Track Number (TN), it transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message. If the Dropped TN is reported by another IU after this transmission, the C2 JU retains the Dropped TN as a remote track and shall not reattempt to correlate the Retained TN and the Dropped TN for a period of 60 seconds after the transmission of the J7.0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific error or conflict handling path where a remote update occurs after a drop command, requiring a 60-second suspension of correlation.

evidence_cards.content: Correlation is deemed to have failed if no J7.0 (ACT = 0) is received for the dropped TN after a period of 60 seconds from the transmission of the correlation request. In this case, all associated processing for the correlation shall be cancelled.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the timeout exception condition for a correlation request and the required system action (cancel processing).

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU's local track (TN A) is identified as the target of a J10.2 Engagement Status message for a current engagement, it decorrelates the track and alerts the operator to transmit a J10.2 message with Weapon Engagement Status field set to 8 (Engagement Broken) if appropriate.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the exception flow handling for track identity conflicts arising from reported engagements.

evidence_cards.content: If the local track (TN A) is the subject of a pending J9.0 Command message, the C2 JU executes decorrelation and provides operator display of new track status before releasing the J9.0 reply.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the exception flow handling when a command message interferes with track identity.

evidence_cards.content: If the local track (TN A) is controlled by own unit (subject of a J10.5 message), automatic decorrelation is inhibited. If manually decorrelated, the operator is alerted to report termination of control of TN A, and commencement of control of the new track is reported using J10.5 only if initiated by operator action.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the exception flow and inhibition logic for tracks under current control assignments.

evidence_cards.content: If the local track (TN A) has been paired by own unit (subject of a J10.6 message), the C2 JU decorrelates and alerts the operator as a cue to terminate the pairing on TN A and initiate the pairing on TN B if appropriate.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the exception flow handling when a pairing status conflicts with decorrelation requirements.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not report a TQ value which has an associated positional accuracy which is better than that associated with own unit's current geodetic position quality.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a constraint on reporting behavior: if the unit's own position quality is worse than the track's TQ, the TQ cannot be reported as-is, effectively forcing an adjustment or exception handling for positional accuracy discrepancies.

evidence_cards.content: When reported on the Surveillance NPG by a C² JU, a TQ value as specified in Table 4.4-7 shall be initially assigned to a track not locally acquired but obtained via a J12.6 Target Sorting message from a nonC² JU; the C² JU shall extrapolate the received target's position to the time of transmission. If the C² JU has correlated local sensor data for the track, this paragraph need not be applied with regard to TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative path/exception handling for tracks received from non-C² units (via J12.6). It specifies the exception to standard local correlation (skipping the table lookup) if local sensor data is already correlated.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU assumes R^2 (Reporting Responsibility) if it has not received a remote report on a locally held Air or Surface track for approximately 40 seconds, or on a locally held Land track for approximately 120 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific error handling path where the C2 JU takes over reporting responsibility due to a timeout (lack of communication from other units).

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a locally held track and local reporting eligibility remains, it shall assume R^2 at the next transmission opportunity, provided a remote report has not been received.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the procedure for the C2 JU to resume reporting responsibility following a drop track notification.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU receives a J2 PPLI message (with NPS Indicator set to Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure) from a JU that holds R^2, it may assume R^2 at the next transmission opportunity if local reporting eligibility remains and no remote report is received.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the condition for the C2 JU to assume responsibility when the responsible unit reports an error or failure state.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU is holding R^2 for a nonreal-time track with the TQ field set to 0, it shall assume R^2 for that track when it is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific logic path for assuming responsibility on nonreal-time tracks that have lost track quality.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU relinquishes R^2 for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report in which the remote Track Quality (TQ) is greater than the local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the exception condition where reporting responsibility is automatically transferred due to a superior data quality report from a peer.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU relinquishes R^2 for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with a TQ equal to the local TQ, provided the reporting JU's Station Number (STN) is greater than the local STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the tie-breaking exception condition for transferring reporting responsibility when track quality is equal.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not transmit an initial surveillance report on a ballistic missile if the predicted time to impact is less than 16 seconds. Similarly, if the altitude of the descending ballistic missile is less than 8 data miles, an initial Ballistic Missile surveillance report shall not be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies timing and altitude constraints that suppress normal surveillance reporting for ballistic missiles, representing a deviation from standard track reporting behavior.

evidence_cards.content: Upon transmission or reception of a Drop Track Report for a ballistic missile, the JU with R² of the Launch Point or Impact Point shall transmit the Impact Point and/or Launch Point messages with the Connect/Disconnect field set to value 1, Disconnect. Any subsequent reports shall be transmitted with the Related 2 Track Number field set to value 0, No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific exception handling procedure for dropping a ballistic missile track, requiring the JU to actively disconnect associated point messages.

evidence_cards.content: If locally derived IFF/SIF data differs from IFF/SIF data that was being reported in the PPLI message, the locally derived data shall be reported.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the handling for data inconsistency (exception) between local and previously reported IFF/SIF values.

evidence_cards.content: Subsurface tracks shall not be correlated with IU tracks (Inertial Update or similar internal tracks).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception constraint on correlation processing for subsurface tracks, prohibiting association with internal units.

evidence_cards.content: When a remote report being tested for correlation is a J2.0 Indirect PPLI message with the Originator E/C field set to value 0 (Surface) or 3 (Air), the C2 JU processes it for correlation like a J3.2 air or J3.3 surface track with TQ = 7 or more.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception in how indirect PPLI messages are handled compared to standard direct reports.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if any of the following restrictions exist: (a) the tracks have different Identity (ID) difference, (b) the Mode II code is different and the local code is current, (c) both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks, or (d) either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines specific conditions under which the automatic correlation process (Step 3) must be inhibited.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.0 Correlation Status message, applied for two tracks which pass the correlation tests specified in paragraph 4.4.4.3.1f, is subject to any operational contingency constraints (OCC) of the below operational contingency constraints.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific message (J7.0) and its dependency on correlation tests.

evidence_cards.content: The TN is the subject of a pending J9.0 Command message originated by a non-C2 JU, or a J9.0 Assignment message signalled by the JU to which it has Reporting Responsibility.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a condition where correlation is restricted due to pending command messages from other sources.

evidence_cards.content: Systems shall have an initialization parameter and an operator selectable capability to inhibit automatic correlation by default. Use of this capability will be subject to interface coordination.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system capability to manually override exception flow rules.

evidence_cards.content: If the correlation request fails to complete (e.g., no J7.0 message received within 60 seconds), the C2 JU retains the Dropped TN as a remote track and shall not reattempt correlation for 60 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the error handling and timing constraint (60 seconds) when correlation fails.

evidence_cards.content: If a Track Number (TN A) is the subject of a handover which is in progress, the decorrelation process shall be delayed until the handover is completed or terminated. Once complete, the decorrelation is executed, an operator is alerted as a cue to report control in the J10.5 Controlling Unit Report message, and an operator display of the pending decorrelation is provided.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception flow for handling decorrelation when a target is mid-handover, defining the delay, execution, and alerting requirements.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.7 EW Product Information Message shall be used to report LOBs derived from various sources such as ES, jam strobes, or radio direction finding (RDF) equipment.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the message type and data content used for post-activity surveillance reporting of EW data.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU drops or ceases reporting EW information, it has transmitted a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system action and message state at the end of the EW reporting lifecycle, which is part of the post-conditions for using the Surveillance Network PG.

evidence_cards.content: For the Termination of Electronic Warfare Surveillance Data, the C2 JU ensures transmission is terminated when information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state regarding data validity at the conclusion of the EW product reporting use case.

evidence_cards.content: In the context of Electronic Warfare Information Reporting Responsibility, the unit initiating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report always retains reporting responsibility; it is illegal to assume reporting responsibility for another unit's AOP.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the final responsibility state of the reporting system for EW products.

evidence_cards.content: Upon completion of the correlation process, the system state reflects one of the following dispositions for the Dropped Track Number: (1) If the Identity of the Retained TN and Dropped TN are the same, the associated identification data (Platform, Platform Activity, Platform Specific) is combined into a single track. (2) If the Identity of the Retained TN and Dropped TN are different and the C2 JU has Reporting Responsibility (R²), it transmits a J7.0 (ACT=0) message before the expiration of the 60-second correlation timeout period. (3) If the C2 JU does not have R² and no correlation is achieved, the Dropped TN is retained as a remote track and shall not be reattempted to correlate for a period of 60 seconds after the transmission of the J7.0 message. (4) Any nonzero Mode I, II, or III IFF/SIF data for a mode for which the Retained TN data is zero is transferred to the Retained TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the final system state (retained vs. remote tracks, combined identities, data transfer) after the use case of correlation completes successfully or times out.

evidence_cards.content: Data specified for the Dropped Track Number (Retained TN) is transferred to the Retained TN. Specifically, correlation data is transferred if the correlation is established; otherwise, only data for the Retained TN is retained.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the postcondition for data retention and transfer upon the conclusion of the correlation process.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation request is transmitted and no J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received for the Dropped TN within a period of 60 seconds, the C2 JU cancels all associated processing for the correlation. If the C2 JU holds Reporting Responsibility (R²) for the Dropped TN, it transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the postcondition state when the correlation process fails due to a timeout.

evidence_cards.content: The minimum wait before reporting air and surface tracks is 12 seconds and for land tracks is 48 seconds after initially achieving Active status or returning to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a mandatory system timing state required after the trigger (reaching Active status) and before the main flow action (transmitting tracks).

evidence_cards.content: The ballistic missile covariance data shall be transmitted with the root variances of the covariance matrix and elements of the Cholesky decomposition of the precompensated correlation matrix.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the final state of the ballistic missile data transmission format after the process of determining and formatting covariance data is complete.

evidence_cards.content: Ballistic Missile Tracks are automatically purged from the system after a specific time interval, and information differences on the interface are resolved through J7 messages, operator procedures, or voice coordination.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the state of ballistic missile data (automatic purge) and the resolution state of conflicting data after the exchange process concludes.

evidence_cards.content: EW detections are determined as eligible for transmission on the Surveillance Network PG (either manually or via automatic association). EW reports (LOBs, AOPs, fixes) may be amplified by additional continuation words if data are available, and Reporting Responsibility is retained by the originating unit.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the final state of EW surveillance data: its eligibility for transmission and the constraints on its modification (amplification) and control (responsibility) within the network.

evidence_cards.content: The AOP resulting from previously reported LOBs is assigned a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the LOBs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the specific state of the Track Number (TN) assignment when a track transitions into an Area of Probability (AOP) postcondition.

evidence_cards.content: The AOP resulting from two or more previously reported fixes of differing TNs is assigned a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the fixes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the specific state of the Track Number (TN) assignment when multiple fixes result in an AOP postcondition.

evidence_cards.content: The new TN assigned to the AOP is used for all subsequent updates of the AOP.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This confirms the state persistence of the newly assigned TN in the system's tracking database.

evidence_cards.content: The unit originating the J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report retains reporting responsibility for that report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the state of Reporting Responsibility (R^2) assignment after the report is published.

evidence_cards.content: When a correlation is found with a track for which the C2 JU has R² and the Track Numbers (TNs) are different, the C2 JU transmits a J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message (Source TN as Retained TN, surveillance TN as Dropped TN), ceases reporting the track, and transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message to the Surveillance Network PG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the state of the C2 JU and the network messages generated after a specific successful correlation scenario involving a track with retained Reporting Responsibility (R²).

evidence_cards.content: When a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R² and the TNs are different, the C2 JU transmits a J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message (Source TN as Retained TN, surveillance TN as Dropped TN).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system's state and the Correlation message transmitted after successfully correlating a remote track for which the C2 JU does not have reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: When a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R² and the TNs are the same, the C2 JU accepts the PPLI information into its surveillance database and disregards the J31 surveillance data on that specific track (unless Geodetic Position values in the PPLI message are below 0, in which case the track number and identity are maintained from the J31).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state after merging a remote track where another JU has R² and TNs match, specifically detailing how the local database is updated and which data sources are prioritized.

evidence_cards.content: When a J12.6 message is received on the Surveillance Network PG indicating a track has been lost (Track Quality = 0), the C2 JU discards the message; however, if another C2 JU assumes R² of the IU, the track number and identity are maintained.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system state after processing a J12.6 loss-of-track message, specifically noting the exception where track identity is preserved during a change in Reporting Responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: Subsurface tracks shall not be correlated with IUs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a permanent state constraint/postcondition: the C2 JU does not perform correlation operations involving Subsurface tracks and Information Units (IUs).

evidence_cards.content: Correlation tests shall include active IUs, remote real-time tracks, and other local tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the comprehensive set of system state checks (correlation targets) required when processing a new track, ensuring the final published track is not a duplicate of any active entity.

evidence_cards.content: If an operator action has been taken which selectively released a new local track for reporting, the track shall be transmitted, regardless of the results of correlation testing.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific override state where the postcondition for reporting is satisfied by operator intervention, bypassing the normal automatic correlation logic.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not report a TQ value which has an associated positional accuracy which is better than that associated with own unit's current geodetic position quality.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a post-use-case constraint on the reported TQ value relative to the unit's geodetic position accuracy.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not artificially increase TQ between sensor inputs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a post-use-case condition regarding the consistency of the TQ value across transmissions.

evidence_cards.content: If the C2 JU has correlated local sensor data for the track, the TQ value specified in Table 4.4-7 shall be initially assigned to tracks not locally acquired.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the state of the assigned TQ value for non-locally acquired tracks that are successfully correlated or received via specific messages.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU relinquishes R2 for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report where the remote TQ is greater than the local TQ, or upon reception of a remote track report with a TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose STN is greater than the local STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system state transition (loss of R2) that occurs as a result of the data exchange process.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU with R2 on a track retains responsibility until the R2 is relinquished in accordance with the defined rules (such as those in paragraph i) or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the persistence of system responsibility (R2) as a post-state of the exchange process until a termination condition is met.

evidence_cards.content: For Inactive Interface Units (IUs) that are no longer active on the interface but for which the C2 JU holds local data, the system state results in the JU assuming Reporting Responsibility (R²) by reporting a J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message using the inactive IU address as the reference Track Number (TN).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the postcondition for the specific use case of reporting inactive IUs: the JU must assume R² and report via J3.4 using the IU address as TN.

evidence_cards.content: After a previously inactive IU returns to the interface as an Active IU, the system state is defined such that the JU holding R² must cease reporting the IU, but it shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the final system state upon the successful return of an IU to Active status: cessation of reporting without a Drop Track message.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU resolves any conflicts between locally derived information and information reported on the interface by transmitting the appropriate J7 message, by operator procedure, or by voice coordination.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the required system state/action after handling data conflicts during the track reporting use case.

evidence_cards.content: If a ballistic missile track is considered lost (no local sensor data received since last update), subsequent reports on that track must include data held at the time of the last sensor contact, and the Lost Track Indicator field must be set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific system state change (setting Lost Track Indicator to 1) required after a track is considered lost during the reporting process.

evidence_cards.content: Ballistic missile tracks must be time-tagged to the integer second nearest to the measurement time; all position, velocity, and covariance data must be extrapolated or interpolated to this referenced time with an accuracy of 0.3 milliseconds or less.
